claims_checked.claim: Convenience stores commonly sell cheap vinyl umbrellas (biniru-gasa).
claims_checked.note: Standard konbini / 100-yen shop retail; prices vary, article does not freeze a yen figure.

claims_checked.claim: Everyone in Japan uses an umbrella in any light rain.
claims_checked.note: Article rejects; hoods, bikes, rural car trips, youth style.

claims_checked.claim: Rain umbrellas are the same as summer sun parasols (higasa).
claims_checked.note: Article distinguishes UV/heat parasols from rain.

claims_checked.claim: Walk–train–walk commuting plus humidity makes light rain costly for clothes.
claims_checked.note: Lived-practice explanation; not a meteorological study.

caveats_about_absolutes: Regional weather and bicycle culture change the picture
Avoid inventing a national yen price for vinyl umbrellas
